text:
Omar: quick ping — PR open: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform-sdk/pull/614. Changes: rest client retry/backoff + streaming client backpressure handling. Need 2 approvals; aiming to merge EOD PT if no blockers.

Maya: taking a look now. Quick skim: retry logic looks good. Want to run smoke locally against staging.

Chris: I can review streaming client today. Any easy repro steps to hit the backpressure path?

Omar: thanks. curl to exercise stream backpressure:
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"long stream payload..."}' https://staging-api.redwood.dev/v1/generate/stream
```
There's also a flaky test in CI: test/streaming.test.ts timeout — I bumped it to 5s in this branch.

Maya: also heads-up that docs need a short note for new `streamOptions.backpressure` flag. small docs patch would be great.

Jen: FYI, if this lands before 9am PT tomorrow we can include it in the partner demo.

Chris: found a potential race in kv cache access when aborting streams; I'll push a tiny fix as a follow-up PR. For this PR, I can approve once tests are stable.

Omar: pushed test timeout bump + docs update in the same PR (commit abcdef1). Thanks.

pr-bot: CI: all checks passed — 12/12 green (build, unit, e2e, lint).

Maya: :thumbsup:

Chris: Approved. :shipit:

Omar: thanks everyone — merging now and will cut a patch release. Will post release notes after tag.
